description: This file implements resource grid management for a scheduler in a wireless communication system, including classes and methods for handling resource blocks, subslot grids, collision detection, and resource allocation for carriers and slots.

classes.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid
classes.description: Manages resource blocks within a carrier subslot, including filling, clearing, collision detection, and used resource calculations.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_grid
classes.description: Represents the resource grid for a cell slot, managing multiple carriers and their resource blocks.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator
classes.description: Allocates resources within a cell slot, managing slot indication and resource grid filling/clearing.

classes.name: cell_resource_allocator
classes.description: Coordinates resource allocation across the entire cell, managing multiple slot resource grids and slot indications.

methods.name: get_max_scs
methods.description: Returns the maximum subcarrier spacing from a list, assuming it is sorted.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::clear
methods.description: Clears the resource blocks in the grid.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::fill
methods.description: Fills the resource grid with specified OFDM symbols and resource blocks or list of CRBs.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::collides
methods.description: Checks for collision with another resource grid or CRB list within specified symbols.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::used_crbs
methods.description: Returns used CRBs within specified resource block limits and symbols.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::used_prbs
methods.description: Returns used PRBs within specified resource block limits and symbols.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::all_set
methods.description: Checks if all resource blocks within specified symbols and CRBs are set.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::fill
methods.description: Fills resource grid for a specific grant or CRB list.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::clear
methods.description: Clears resource grid for a specific grant or CRB list.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::collides
methods.description: Checks for collision with specified resource blocks or symbols.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::used_crbs
methods.description: Returns used CRBs for a given BWP configuration or specific scs and CRB limits.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::used_prbs
methods.description: Returns used PRBs for a given scs, CRB limits, and symbols.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::all_set
methods.description: Checks if all resource blocks within specified symbols and CRBs are set.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::get_carrier
methods.description: Retrieves the carrier resource grid for a given subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator::slot_indication
methods.description: Indicates a new slot point and initializes resource grids accordingly.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator::clear
methods.description: Clears all resource allocations and results.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication, setting up resource grids for the slot.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::stop
methods.description: Stops resource allocation and clears all slot data.
